validation_scenarios.name: audience reframe with preserved artifact

validation_scenarios.name: revision synchronization

turns.prompt:
Create a liquidity stress ladder and covenant board for a treasury liquidity committee. This is a presentation artifact, not an interactive dashboard. Keep it as one liquidity stress ladder and covenant board in the first viewport.

Situation: Company: Meridian Devices. Cash pools US/EU/APAC, revolver R1, covenant test, payroll run, vendor batch, FX hedge, rating call.
Current state: US cash $42M, EU cash $18M trapped, APAC $9M, revolver availability $60M, covenant headroom 1.2x amber, payroll $24M due, vendor batch $31M pending.
Timeline: 08:00 cash pull, 09:30 covenant model, 11:00 FX hedge, 13:00 payroll release, 15:00 vendor decision, 17:00 rating call.
Sources: S1 bank feed, S2 treasury workstation, S3 covenant model, S4 payroll file, S5 AP ledger, S6 rating agenda.

Requirements: 1. The first viewport must be dominated by one coherent visual artifact, not a grid of detached KPI cards. 2. Show the main entities, current states, source markers S1-S6, timeline, legend, and four connected callouts. 3. The callouts must cover EU trapped cash, covenant headroom, payroll due, vendor batch. 4. Use polished domain-appropriate styling with readable labels and no critical overlap.

Reframe it for the CFO. Preserve the liquidity ladder; add exactly three funding decisions: draw R1, release payroll, defer vendor batch. Add two leader-linked lenses for covenant headroom and trapped EU cash.

Update at 14:20: covenant headroom drops to 0.9x red, R1 availability falls to $44M, payroll is released, vendor batch is split with $12M paid. Recompute liquidity runway and priority order so covenant headroom becomes the top red constraint while payroll is no longer blocked. Synchronize ladder, decisions, timeline, source tags, callouts, and change note. Do not leave covenant headroom amber.
Create a board risk memo page. Fit liquidity ladder, funding decisions, covenant ledger, source tags S1-S6, and timeline in the first viewport.

Add a rating-agency Q&A preview beside the board memo. It must preserve covenant 0.9x red, R1 $44M, payroll released, vendor split with $12M paid, revised runway/priority interpretation, and source markers, while using external-facing wording. Keep the full board memo synchronized.
